name: Stormpike's Request
summary: From Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike sends Furen Longbeard a commission for a fine dwarven shield.

sections.title: A Northern Commission
sections.body: Mountaineer Stormpike stands watch in Loch Modan, where the dwarven frontier brings danger. He needs a sturdy shield and trusts no ordinary smith with such work. Furen Longbeard is the armorsmith whose craft he admires. Furen left Ironforge and now lives among the humans in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Stormpike assumes a king's ransom drew him south, so he relies on travelers to carry his request across the kingdoms.

sections.title: The Stormpike Line
sections.body: Furen Longbeard receives Stormpike's letter in Stormwind's Dwarven District and agrees to make the shield. The Stormpike clan is proud and established, known across Khaz Modan for martial grit and wealth. Word and business from his northern homeland are welcome. So Furen sets to work on the mountaineer's order.

faq.answer: From Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike asks Furen Longbeard to forge him a fine shield.
Mountaineer Stormpike wrote the letter. He is a dwarven sentry guarding Loch Modan's passes and admires Furen Longbeard's smithing.

faq.q: Where does this letter need to go?
aliases: where do i take stormpikes request
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Furen Longbeard at his forge in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Why does Stormpike hire a smith all the way in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormpike considers Furen's skill unmatched and will accept no other armorer. Furen left Ironforge to work among the humans in the south.

angles.text: Stormpike's request shows the standing of master armorers. Patrons across kingdoms seek skilled dwarven smiths.
As a dwarf, you share a bond of clan and craft with mountaineers guarding Khaz Modan and craftsmen living abroad in human cities.
